hypothesis: The frozen late-swing actor latches the left foot too early; when gait support changes before contact, measured revalidation can redirect the kick to the airborne right foot and avoid right-knee contact.
baseline: Independent-instance frozen late-swing actor with swing-side revalidation disabled and support-knee action disabled.
candidate: Same frozen actor and SONIC, revalidate_swing_side=true, release_height_advantage_m=0.02; no support-knee action.
development_gate: Both knee-only courses become foot-only, or reject the candidate; no compensating evidence from batch lanes.
